# address place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:addressPlace`](gmeow-addressPlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/addressPlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The geographic place a postal address denotes (typically the premises/building) — the seam from the as-written address to the resolved place hierarchy, its coordinates/geometry, and its external identifiers.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PostalAddress`](../classes/gmeow-PostalAddress.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:addressPlace`](gmeow-addressPlace.md) from [`gmeow:PostalAddress`](../classes/gmeow-PostalAddress.md) to [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to cross from the as-written surface form of an address to the resolved, identifier-bearing geographic place — the point at which coordinates, geometry, and external place IDs become available.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to restate the surface components (those are the datatype properties) and avoid attaching geometry to the address itself; geometry lives on the resolved [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md).

### How to use

- Link the address to its premises [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md), then walk [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md) for the enclosing hierarchy; mark [`gmeow:coarsenTo`](gmeow-coarsenTo.md) on the address so a public projection resolves only to the enclosing locality.

### Examples

- ex:home [`gmeow:addressPlace`](gmeow-addressPlace.md) ex:premisesPlace.

### Avoid For Consumers

- [`gmeow:consumerPublicSite`](../individuals/gmeow-consumerPublicSite.md)
- [`gmeow:consumerWikidata`](../individuals/gmeow-consumerWikidata.md)
